svg.title: Props flow down from parent to child like function arguments: App passes name and price to ProductCard; the child cannot change its props; to change data, the parent passes a callback such as onAdd that the child calls

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Noto Sans', sans-serif

svg.text: Props go down, events come up

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Noto Sans', sans-serif

svg.text: The parent owns the data; children receive props and call callbacks.
